snippet.title: Health Audit Simulator - Official Announcement Trailer (2026)
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4336300/Health_Audit_Simulator/

Coming Soon. Assume the role of a Health Audit Inspector and find hidden risks across 20 levels, each with Easy and Hard mode variants.

Releasing on Steam Spring 2026. Wishlist now to stay up to date on latest developments, including the demo which debuts soon!

Health Audit Simulator is a solo independent game project, made by Ryan Mcleod, operating as Leithen Games.
